summary: Swvl Holdings Corp furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release dated September 22, 2026, announcing entry into Madinah, Saudi Arabia, via a 24/7 shuttle service linking seven hotels to Al-Masjid an-Nabawi. The agreement covers fixed route planning, real-time dispatching, and round-the-clock operations. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update on a commercial contract win and regional expansion, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
